71153-the-sacred-dance.title: A Study In Comparative Folklore
71153-the-sacred-dance.creator: W. O. E. Oesterley, D.D.
71153-the-sacred-dance.description: A book by W. O. E. Oesterley, D.D.. Our study is concerned with the “sacred” dance; that this epithet applied to the dance, at any rate during the earlier phases of its history and as still practised among many uncultured and even some semi-cultured peoples to-day, is more than justified, the following pages will, it is hoped, show.

arxiv-1912-09837.title: A measurement of soft-drop jet observables in p ​ p pp collisions with the ATLAS detector at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\penalty\ \text{Te\kern-1.00006ptV}
arxiv-1912-09837.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1912-09837.description: Abstract Jet substructure quantities are measured using jets groomed with the soft-drop grooming procedure in dijet events from 32.9 fb -1 of p ​ p pp collisions collected with the ATLAS detector at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\penalty\ \text{Te\kern-1.00006ptV} . These observables are sensitive to a wide range of QCD phenomena.

arxiv-2011-11624.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of particle collisions in quantum spin chains
arxiv-2011-11624.creator: P. I. Karpov, G.-Y. Zhu, M. P. Heller, M. Heyl
arxiv-2011-11624.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by P. I. Karpov, G.-Y. Zhu, M. P. Heller, M. Heyl. Recent developments have highlighted the potential of quantum spin models to realize the phenomenology of confinement leading to the formation of bound states such as mesons. In this work we show that Ising chains also provide a platform to realize and probe particle collisions in pristine form with the key advantage that one can not only monitor the asymptotic particle production, but also the whole spatiotemporal dynamics of the collision event.

arxiv-2012-09918.title: Sorting in Memristive Memory Thanks: This work was supported in part by the Louisiana Board of Regents Support Fund no. LEQSF(2020-23)-RDA- 26, National Science Foundation grant #2019511, and generous gift from Cisco
arxiv-2012-09918.creator: Mohsen Riahi Alam, M. Hassan Najafi, Nima TaheriNejad
arxiv-2012-09918.description: Abstract . Sorting data is needed in many application domains. Traditionally, the data is read from memory and sent to a general-purpose processor or application-specific hardware for sorting. The sorted data is then written back to the memory. Reading/writing data from/to memory and transferring data between memory and processing unit incur significant latency and energy overhead.

arxiv-2202-10791.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study a class of pseudo-differential operators known as time-frequency localization operators on ℤ n {\mathbb{Z}}^{n} , which depend on a symbol ς \varsigma and two windows functions g 1 g_{1} and g 2 g_{2} .

arxiv-2209-00933.title: Screened extended Koopmans’ theorem: photoemission at weak and strong correlation
arxiv-2209-00933.creator: S. Di Sabatino, J. Koskelo, J. A. Berger, P. Romaniello
arxiv-2209-00933.description: Abstract By introducing electron screening in the extended Koopmans’ theorem we correctly describe the band gap opening in weakly as well as strongly correlated systems. We show this by applying our method to bulk LiH, Si, and paramagnetic as well as antiferromagnetic NiO.

arxiv-2211-13602.title: Measuring the Quantum State of Dark Matter
arxiv-2211-13602.creator: David J. E. Marsh a
arxiv-2211-13602.description: Abstract I demonstrate a simple example of how the time series obtained from searches for ultralight bosonic dark matter (DM), such as the axion, can be used to determine whether it is in a coherent or incoherent quantum state. The example is essentially trivial, but I hope that explicitly addressing it provokes experimental exploration.

arxiv-2406-17741.title: Point-SAM: Promptable 3D Segmentation Model for Point Clouds
arxiv-2406-17741.creator: Yuchen Zhou, Jiayuan Gu, Tung Yen Chiang, Fanbo Xiang, Hao Su
arxiv-2406-17741.description: Abstract The development of 2D foundation models for image segmentation has been significantly advanced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, achieving similar success in 3D models remains a challenge due to issues such as non-unified data formats, poor model scalability, and the scarcity of labeled data with diverse masks.

arxiv-2409-09059.title: SDP Synthesis of Distributionally Robust Backward Reachable Trees for Probabilistic Planning
arxiv-2409-09059.creator: Naman Aggarwal, Jonathan P. How
arxiv-2409-09059.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Naman Aggarwal, Jonathan P. How. The paper presents Maximal Ellipsoid Backward Reachable Trees MAXELLIPSOID BRT, which is a multi-query algorithm for planning of dynamic systems under stochastic motion uncertainty and constraints on the control input.

arxiv-2410-16017.title: Semiparametric Bayesian Inference for a Conditional Moment Equality Model
arxiv-2410-16017.creator: Christopher D. Walker
arxiv-2410-16017.description: Abstract . I propose a semiparametric Bayesian inference framework for conditional moment equalities. The core idea is that these models deterministically map a conditional distribution of data to a structural parameter via the restriction that a conditional expectation equals zero.

arxiv-2509-14342.title: Multi-Quadruped Cooperative Object Transport: Learning Decentralized Pinch-Lift-Move
arxiv-2509-14342.creator: Bikram Pandit, Aayam Kumar Shrestha, Alan Fern
arxiv-2509-14342.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bikram Pandit, Aayam Kumar Shrestha, Alan Fern. We study decentralized cooperative transport using teams of N N -quadruped robots with arm that must pinch, lift, and move ungraspable objects through physical contact alone. Unlike prior work that relies on rigid mechanical coupling between robots and objects, we address the more challenging setting where mechanically independent robots must coordinate through contact forces alone without any communication or centralized control.

arxiv-2511-04627.title: The phase-field model of fracture incorporating Mohr-Coulomb, Mogi-Coulomb, and Hoek-Brown strength surfaces
arxiv-2511-04627.creator: S. Chockalingam, Adrian Buganza Tepole, Aditya Kumar
arxiv-2511-04627.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. Chockalingam, Adrian Buganza Tepole, Aditya Kumar. Classical phase-field theories of brittle fracture capture toughness-controlled crack growth but do not account for the material’s strength surface, which governs fracture nucleation in the absence of cracks. The phase-field formulation of Kumar et al. (2020) proposed a blueprint for incorporating the strength surface while preserving toughness-controlled propagation by introducing a nucleation driving force and presented results for the Drucker-Prager surface. Following this blueprint, Chockalingam (2025) recently derived a general driving-force expression that incorporates arbitrary strength surfaces.

pmc-11331376.creator: Jun Park, Chong-Sam Na
pmc-11331376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The objective of this study was to identify genomic regions and candidate genes associated with productive traits using a total of 37,099 productive records and 6,683 single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data obtained from five Great-Grand-Parents (GGP) farms in Landrace. The estimated of heritabilities for days to 105 kg (AGE), average daily gain (ADG), backfat thickness (BF), and eye muscle area (EMA) were 0.49, 0.49, 0.56, and 0.23, respectively.

pmc-13171996.description: The increasing efficacy of oncological therapies has led to a rapidly growing population of cancer survivors, shifting clinical attention from acute treatment-related toxicities to long-term and late sequelae. Among these, dermatological sequelae represent some of the most visible and persistent consequences of cancer treatments and may significantly impair quality of life.

pmc-13231683.creator: José Carlos Gasca-Aldama, Osvaldo Alexis Marché Fernández, Jesús Enrique Castrejón Sánchez
pmc-13231683.description: ECCO₂R was assumed to guarantee safety. However, as Barbič et al. noted, centrifugal pumps are designed for high flows (3–6 L/min). Forcing them to operate at low flows (350–500 mL/min) increases circuit resistance and blood trauma. Admittedly, the severe bleeding reported in major trials (e.g., SUPERNOVA, REST, VENT-AVOID) was multifactorial.

pmc-13452325.title: Structured multi-domain EEG descriptors with phase-based connectivity for lie and truth detection
pmc-13452325.creator: Dwi Utari Surya, Sholeh Hadi Pramono, Panca Mudjirahardjo, Muhammad Aziz Muslim, Cries Avian, Mahdin Rohmatillah
pmc-13452325.description: Wearable EEG-based Lie and Truth detection requires structured descriptor engineering to achieve reproducible results and ensure method transparency. The existing approaches use loosely integrated features alongside hidden modeling methods, which create challenges for understanding their results and verifying research progress across different studies. The existing research gap requires the development of a deterministic descriptor framework to document wearable EEG systems.

pmc-13453797.description: s bilateral lung transplant in a high-risk patient who was a Jehovah's Witness. pmc-13459203.title: Subacute normotensive cardiac tamponade as the initial presentation of metastatic lung adenocarcinoma: a case report
pmc-13459203.creator: Mohd Aizuddin Mohd Zulastri, Muhammad Azlan Aseri, Syed Saleh Syed Sheikh, Izzah Nazura Ismail, Imran Zainal Abidin
pmc-13459203.description: BackgroundMalignant pericardial effusion as the initial presentation of lung cancer is rare, and its diagnosis can be challenging, particularly when clinical features mimic common infectious or cardiogenic conditions. This case highlights the value of echocardiography and pericardial fluid cytology in identifying occult malignancy in patients with persistent cardiorespiratory symptoms and inconclusive initial workup.

pmc-13589090.creator: Chrissy Liu, Yasmin Abozenah, Thomas J. Rutherford, Vaagn Andikyan, Adrian Kohut, Matthew L. Anderson
pmc-13589090.description: BackgroundPathogenic ARID1A mutations are common in uterine carcinosarcoma (UCS) and may confer vulnerability to the combination of temozolomide (TMZ) and a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor (PARPi) through synthetic lethality. Clinical experience with this regimen in gynecologic cancers is limited and has not been reported in UCS.
